events.title: Chilling, playing FRAGA and chatting with the devs!
events.summary: Hey everyone!I'm Lorenzo, one of the two developers behind FRAGA, a turn-based tactical roguelite inspired by Galician mythology and folklore.I'll be playing the demo, exploring the forest, fighting its weird creatures, making questionable decisions and probably getting myself into trouble.Got questions about the game, how it was made, or anything else? events.title: Demo is now public!
events.summary: Demo is now public!It’s been a long time, but we can finally see the final stretch of the road... Get it? Like the road a pilgrim walks... Anyway, enough messing around.There’s not much more to say. We’ve come a long way, and a big part of that is thanks to everyone who has been there with us in one way or another. events.title: Private demo starts!
events.summary: The private demo begins!After spending a long time showcasing FRAGA at in-person events throughout Galicia, we’re finally taking the next step: the private demo is now available to content creators!From now on, you will be able to explore the world of FRAGA, experience the game for yourself, share it with your communities and, most importantly, provide us with your feedback.
